title: Metric Markov Cotype Two of ℓ1
main_claim: ℓ1 has metric Markov cotype two (Mendel–Naor Def. 1.2) with N_2(ℓ1) ≤ 12√21 (C^2 = 3024). Corollaries: N_2(ℓ1(C)) ≤ 12√42, and Lipschitz maps from Hilbert subsets into ℓ1 extend with a universal constant.
coverage: I read the full LaTeX (648 lines) and checked every step by hand. Cut lemma: the threshold decomposition, the identity ||x_i−x_j||_1 = ||z_i−z_j||_{1,w} = ||z_i−z_j||_H^2, and contractivity of T with w_B = ||b_B||_1 all hold. Flat lemma: |φ'(r)| ≤ 6|r−d| holds for both bits; the increment bound 6|a||δ|+3|δ|^2 is correct; the remainder identity R = 2|a|^2|δ|^2 + (2<a,δ>+|δ|^2)^2 checks out, as do |δ|^4 ≤ 4R and the constant 72·(1/2)+18·4 = 108. Martingale corollary: the cross term vanishes under conditional expectation, and convergence is justified by bounded and monotone convergence. Comparison lemma: subadditivity of √D follows from stationarity; D(t) ≤ 4W; E S^2 = 2t^2+t, so E J^2 ≤ 3; q^t ≤ 1/2 gives P(R=r) ≤ 2/t; the total constant 28 is correct. Killed-chain martingale: the first-step identity holds, M_∞ = z_{X_S}, and with center e = z_{X_0} the terminal potential equals ||x_{X_S}−x_{X_0}||_1^2. The jump identity B + (q/p)E_A = B + tE_A is correct, using Φ(z) = z and survival independent of the stationary walk. Final assembly: 108·28 = 3024 = (12√21)^2. Median interpretation: P(at least 2 of 3 in B) = φ(h). Complex corollary: the √2 norm comparison is correct. Numerical check: on 300 random reversible chains in ℓ1^d (n ≤ 6, t ≤ 30), the expected-median y_i gave an LHS/Cesàro-RHS ratio of at most 1.23 (bound 3024) and an LHS/geometric-endpoint ratio of at most 1.02 (bound 108).

issues.description: The extension corollary rests on a loosely paraphrased citation of Mendel–Naor Cor. 1.13 ('in its Banach-space form, a source with Markov type two and a dual Banach target...'). I did not verify the exact hypotheses of the cited result against the original. This affects only the consequence, not Theorem 1.
issues.evidence: The proof says only that ℓ1 = c0^* and that Hilbert space has Markov type 2 with M=1; the precise statement of MN Cor. 1.13 is not reproduced.

sibling_notes: There were no prior entries for family 332 on the board when I checked. I posted a no_gap summary there. The main proof is self-contained and elementary; it does not depend on any companion paper.
